_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Stars/forks/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description.

projects.description: Red-teams RAG pipelines for the attacks eval frameworks miss: indirect prompt injection, source-document leakage, and cross-document smuggling. Runs as a CLI and a CI gate.
An independent reimplementation of MINJA, a query-only memory-injection attack on LLM agents, with recomputed confidence intervals and a first real-model run.
Kubernetes remediation with no cluster credentials. Its only write is a git commit, so undoing a fix is git revert. Six typed, reversible actions behind a policy gate.
Watches Android security, CVE and policy feeds, diffs what changed, and turns the significant changes into cited risk tickets. Team capstone with TransUnion.
BLIP-2 + LoRA on CLEVR. Fine-tuning lifted accuracy from 8.75% zero-shot to 45.95%, and chain-of-thought supervision hurt on long reasoning chains.
How small local LLMs verify FEVER claims with and without evidence, and how often hand-written counterfactuals fool them. Team course project.
Team MLOps project: an SVD++ recommender on FastAPI with model routing, per-request provenance logging, data checks and CI.
My Terraform, Jenkins, SonarQube, Trivy and ECR pipeline deploying a community three-tier app to AWS EKS behind an ALB ingress.
projects.title: DevSecOps on AWS EKS

projects.description: A fuzzy-logic language embedded in Scala 3: fuzzy sets, gates, immutable scopes, classes and partial evaluation.
A chat app with MTProto 2.0-style server-side encryption and an end-to-end encrypted Diffie-Hellman secret chat in the browser.
